Proporcionar atendimento psiquiátrico de qualidade, acessível e humanizado através da telemedicina, promovendo o bem‑estar mental e emocional dos pacientes. O médico geriatra deve atuar com empatia, responsabilidade e ética, garantindo diagnósticos e tratamentos assertivos, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e contribuindo para a melhoria de sua qualidade de vida. Fortalecer a confiança no atendimento remoto, assegurando que cada consulta seja conduzida com o mesmo rigor e acolhimento de um atendimento presencial.

title: KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!
description:
KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig gaat een klaslokaal bouwen in Brazilië!

Dit jaar starten we alweer aan het zevende bestuursjaar van onze stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig. Na de successen van voorgaande jaren in India, Malawi, Zambia en Sri Lanka, gaat KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig dit jaar vol voor stichting Estrela De Fuvela in Rio de Janeiro! Daarom gaan 30 KnappeKoppen dit jaar allemaal in hun eigen stad veel geld inzamelen zodat zij een uitbreiding van een klaslokaal van Estrela de Favela kunnen realiseren!

Lana, Wat is KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig eigenlijk?
KnappeKoppen is ooit ontstaan vanuit een initiatief van studenten uit Amsterdam en Utrecht. Zij wilden graag iets terug doen voor hun stad en anderen. Uit deze mooie visie ontstond Stichting KnappeKoppen Vrijwillig, onderdeel van het commerciële bedrijf KnappeKoppen. Vier studenten vormden in 2018 samen het eerste stichtingsbestuur. Zij begonnen in hun eigen steden met lokale acties, zoals helpen bij de Voedselbank, ouderen een mooie dag bezorgen of kerstpakketten uitdelen. Later realiseerden ze zich dat ze impact wilden maken buiten hun eigen stadsmuren. Sindsdien zet het bestuur van de stichting zich ieder jaar in voor zowel hun eigen stad als voor een mooi (jaarlijks gekozen) internationaal doel.

Niek, waar denk jij dat in Rotterdam op dit moment de meeste behoefte is aan vrijwilligers?
Ik denk dat er in Rotterdam al veel mooie initiatieven zijn die zich inzetten voor de maatschappij. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan Stichting Betrokken Student en Oma’s Soep: twee mooie voorbeelden van organisaties die werken aan verbinding tussen de inwoners van Rotterdam. Toch is er op veel gebieden nog steeds een grote behoefte aan vrijwilligers.

Wij, als KnappeKoppen Rotterdam, zouden bijvoorbeeld maaltijdpakketten kunnen maken voor deze gezinnen of meehelpen bij een van de vele locaties van de Voedselbank. Daarnaast kunnen we soep rondbrengen naar eenzame ouderen en samen met hen een kop koffie drinken.

Sanna, kun je ons meenemen in de plannen voor komend jaar? Wat gaan jullie doen en waar ligt de focus op?
We hebben superveel leuke plannen voor het komende jaar! Een deel daarvan sluit aan bij de tijd van het jaar: zo denken we aan een Valentijnsactie, wijnflessen of kerstbomen verkopen rond de feestdagen en natuurlijk hutspotpakketten tijdens Leidens Ontzet.

Sterre, jullie hebben dit jaar gekozen voor stichting Estrela de Favela. Kun je iets meer vertellen over dit goede doel en waarom juist deze keuze is gemaakt?
Estrela de Favela is een stichting die zich inzet voor kansarme kinderen in de Braziliaanse favela’s. Zij bieden onderwijs aan kinderen van 5 tot 17 jaar, waarbij niet alleen aandacht wordt besteed aan de reguliere schoolvakken, maar ook aan ‘life skills’ en sociale vaardigheden.

Joep, wat is er allemaal nodig om het project te realiseren in Brazilië, en hoe kunnen mensen bijdragen of doneren?
Zoals Sterre vertelde, zetten wij ons dit jaar in om een nieuw klaslokaal mogelijk te maken voor kinderen in de favela! Het ingezamelde geld gaat naar de bouw en inrichting van deze plek, zodat kinderen een veilige omgeving krijgen om te leren, spelen en zich te ontwikkelen.

Keet, wat hopen jij en je bestuur dit jaar te bereiken, en hoe gaan jullie dat als team aanpakken?
Dit jaar willen wij in Groningen laten zien dat je naast je studie ook echt impact kunt maken, zowel lokaal als internationaal. Ons doel is om zoveel mogelijk studenten te betrekken bij onze acties, want hoe meer mensen meedoen, hoe groter het verschil.

Tot slot, Naomi! Hoe ga jij al deze besturen bijstaan dit studiejaar?
Dit jaar heb ik de eer om al deze fantastische KnappeKoppen te begeleiden als manager en te ondersteunen met zowel de lokale acties als natuurlijk het grote project in Rio de Janeiro voor Estrela de Favela waar Sterre jullie al meer over heeft verteld!

About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Purpose

As Buyer, you are responsible for procuring materials, equipment, and services required for project or operations execution. This role involves negotiating contracts and commercial terms, and ensuring timely delivery to support project and operations timelines and budgets.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Planning: You develop and implement procurement plans based on project requirements, timelines, and budgets.

  • Contract Negotiation: You negotiate terms and conditions with suppliers to secure favorable agreements while mitigating risks. You align with the Category Management team as needed.
  • Purchase Orders: You issue and manage purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project specifications and company policies.
  • Cost Control: You ensure procurement activities align with budget constraints and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
  • Compliance: You ensure all procurement activities comply with industry regulations, company policies, and safety standards.
  • Reporting: You provide regular updates to project managers and stakeholders on procurement status, potential risks, and mitigation strategies.

  • Experience in procurement within the oil and gas industry.

  • Knowledge of industry regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment.

Functional Competencies

  • Commercial

  • Project Procurement Strategy and Management
  • SBM Product Knowledge
  • Purchasing Tools and Processes
  • Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management
  • Contract Management

  • Product Costing

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. title: Hedge Accounting Specialist
description:
Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Responsibilities

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis: Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data-driven insights.

You are meant for this job if

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk management
  • In-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)
  • Skills: Communication, Analytical Skills, Risk Management

description:
Join to apply for the MÉDICO ORTOPEDISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento clínico e cirúrgico em Ortopedia nas áreas: CER, enfermarias, centro cirúrgico, unidade de terapia intensiva e ambulatório do Hospital.

title: Hedge Accounting Specialist
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis - Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data-driven insights.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk management
  • In-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

title: Hedge Accounting Specialist
description:
Join to apply for the Hedge Accounting Specialist role at TechnipFMC

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis: Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data‑driven insights.

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk managementIn-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

Skills

  • Communication
  • Analytical Skills
  • Risk Management

Design, Comunicação, Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia, Psicologia, ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com especialização ou cursos de extensão em UX/UI Design, Design de Interação, Experiência do Usuário ou áreas correlatas.

Em projetos de UX/UI Design, com apresentação de portfólio que evidencie resultados concretos, cases de sucesso e participação em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais focados na experiência do usuário. Experiência em design e edição de apresentações profissionais de alto impacto para stakeholders e equipes; Habilidades em edição de vídeos para fins de comunicação, treinamento ou divulgação de produtos digitais; Conhecimento em ferramentas da Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate); Vivência em ambientes que adotam metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, com participação ativa em squads de desenvolvimento.

Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Física, ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com especialização em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning ou campos correlatos.

Experiência:

Conhecimentos:

Domínio de técnicas de Machine Learning, incluindo algoritmos supervisionados e não supervisionados, validação de modelos, análise de desempenho e ajuste de hiperparâmetros; Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem estatística (análise multivariada, séries temporais), testes de hipóteses e inferência estatística; Habilidade avançada em programação, especialmente em Python, utilizando as principais bibliotecas e frameworks para ciência de dados, machine learning e inteligência artificial; Experiência com tecnologias avançadas de IA, incluindo Large Language Models (LLMs) e Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP).

title: Banco de Talentos [A-LAB] - FREELA
description:
Overview

Somos diversos, somos sonhadores e temos o propósito de inspirar nossa comunidade a contar histórias reais com impacto positivo. É por isso que misturamos nossas paixões com trabalho. Dessa forma, queremos conhecer novos talentos que estejam dispostos a trabalhar conosco em formato de freelas. Queremos, cada vez mais, deixar nossas equipes plurais e diversas.

Então, se você quer participar e co-criar histórias e projetos temporários conosco, queremos te conhecer! Se você é freelancer, cadastre-se no banco de talentos e analisaremos seu perfil de acordo com cada uma das oportunidades.

Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Áreas de atuação

  • Direção de arte

É necessário criar conceitos inovadores alinhados aos objetivos de cada marca, além de traduzir ideias criativas em narrativas visuais claras e objetivas. O diretor de arte precisa enxergar estrategicamente além do briefing, contribuindo na confecção das entregas.

Os motions precisam ter conhecimentos em After Effects e Adobe Premier, além de contribuir com referências visuais de animação e criar novas propostas, para animar as artes criadas por diretores de arte.

  • Redação

Os redatores devem ter pensamentos inovadores e uma curiosidade especial para novos formatos e plataformas. É preciso criar conceitos, roteirizar e escrever copies para peças em formatos objetivos e diferentes formatos, otimizando a comunicação de cada rede.

  • Analista de Conteúdo

Os analistas de conteúdo devem transformar estratégias em ações, ajudando a equipe de social nos briefings e ideias para redes sociais. São responsáveis por definir a volumetria ideal de cada rede, montar a grade de conteúdo de forma estratégica e buscar insights.

O estrategista é responsável por definir toda a estratégia de conteúdo de uma marca, além de desenvolver projetos criativos para as redes sociais, cuidar da qualidade do trabalho e definir o tom de voz da marca.

O time de B.I. é responsável por mapear oportunidades para as marcas na redes sociais, sejam elas tendências, comportamentos ou perfis do consumidor. É necessário ter um olhar criativo para poder transformá-lo em insights, estudos e insumos pra criação.

O produtor acompanha e gerencia todas as etapas da produção: desde a definição do cronograma até a entrega final. Ajuda a controlar a pauta dos motions e editores, faz orçamentos e contrato de terceiros.

O gerente de projetos é responsável pela liderança interna do time, organizando a pauta, fazendo o cronograma dos projetos e tendo a visão macro de quais demandas precisam ser priorizadas.

Gerir, cuidar, liderar e desenvolver pessoas do time são algumas das competências de quem realiza atendimento ao cliente. Além disso, é responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente e cuidado com o escopo de cada projeto.

Contratação PJ.

Oi, somos o A-Lab!

Um laboratório de conteúdo criativo que acredita que, nesse mundo de transformações constantes, algoritmos e inteligência artificial, existe uma coisa que não muda: a importância das boas relações.

Tudo que criamos reflete o cuidado e o interesse real que temos pelas pessoas. São essas conexões verdadeiras que impulsionam nossa habilidade de contar histórias mais autênticas, relevantes e integradas às necessidades das marcas e do público.

Exploramos linguagens, narrativas e formatos para ajudar nossos clientes a construírem comunidades engajadas. Já realizamos projetos em parceria com grandes marcas como Burger King, Uber, Faber Castell, Sorvetes Nestlé, Porto e Itaú .

Sabemos que o bem-estar no trabalho é determinante para gerar motivação diante de um mercado tão acelerado e competitivo. Por isso, temos uma cultura organizacional forte, que estimula as relações saudáveis e oferece condições para que nosso time se sinta confiante inspirado para criar.

Cultivamos um ambiente leve e prezamos por uma troca mútua de respeito e transparência. Incentivamos a colaboração e buscamos conectar as paixões individuais dos a-labers com o que fazemos no dia a dia. É isso que nos faz crescer juntos e ser um lugar de potência para quem está se desenvolvendo com a gente.

NOSSO propósito é provar para o mundo que entregas incríveis nascem de relações saudáveis. Bora colocá-las em prática juntos?

description:
SOC Analyst

NTT DATA, Inc. invites applications for the SOC Analyst role. This position focuses on monitoring, analyzing, and responding to security incidents, and managing DNS/SIEM platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot the Infoblox DNS/DHCP/IPAM platform in complex and distributed environments, ensuring high availability and security of DNS services.
  • Configure and maintain DNS zones, records, and security policies to protect against spoofing, tunneling, and exfiltration.
  • Operate SIEM solutions (Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, XSIEM) – create, adjust, and validate correlation rules and use them for threat hunting.
  • Investigate, analyze, and respond to security incidents in real time, correlating events from network, endpoint, and cloud sources.
  • Escalate and coordinate critical incidents with internal teams and global clients, ensuring thorough documentation and timely resolution.
  • Ensure adherence to ITSM processes using ServiceNow, including incident categorization, investigation, and closure.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of security use cases, correlation rules, and dashboards.

Technical Requirements

  • Proven experience with Infoblox solutions and advanced DNS troubleshooting.
  • Hands‑on knowledge of multi‑vendor SIEM platforms and rule development.
  • Previous SOC experience in high‑volume environments, following ITIL/ISO 27001 practices.
  • ServiceNow ITSM experience for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to work in multicultural teams.
  • Analytical mindset, prioritization capability, and proactive improvement culture.

Certifications & Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, Splunk Certified, Sentinel, QRadar, ISO 27001.
  • Infoblox specific training (DDI, Core Network Services, Security Ecosystem Integration).
  • Experience with DNSSEC, Cisco Umbrella, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST frameworks.

Experience

  • Minimum 6 years in cybersecurity, with extensive monitoring, incident response, and Infoblox administration.
  • Demonstrated SOC experience in large enterprises with structured processes and high event volumes.
  • Deep familiarity with Infoblox DDI, multi‑vendor SIEM, and ITSM ServiceNow.

Important Highlights

  • Hybrid remote work available in São Paulo/SP.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Apply now to explore the path to opportunity.

Basic Function

The Director of Real Estate Finance plays a pivotal leadership role in the financial planning, investment strategy, and execution of complex real estate transactions within the Real Estate Development and Capital Asset Management (REDCAM) portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Real Estate Officer, this role is responsible for guiding financial strategy for student housing, commercial development, acquisitions, ground leases, and joint ventures in support of the University’s strategic mission.

This position requires advanced financial acumen, a deep understanding of institutional real estate, and the ability to lead through highly complex development initiatives in alignment with the University’s strategic plan and the approved Campus Master Plan, ensuring portfolio support for institutional goals, risk adherence, and financial sustainability. The Director also fosters teamwork, leadership development, integrity, and service responsiveness, while managing relationships with business partners, regulatory agencies, and stakeholders.

Supervisory Accountability

The incumbent is responsible for overseeing the successful completion of projects, ensuring all contributing parties remain on task, on time, and on budget. While this position does not have formal direct reports, the Director leads cross‑functional deal teams comprised of analysts, external advisors, consultants, and university stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university at large.

External contacts include housing partners, investors, lenders, consultants, contractors, local regulatory agencies, historical societies, surrounding communities, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Financial Analysis and Reporting

Conduct comprehensive financial analyses and prepare reports to assess key performance indicators and operational efficiencies.

Strategic Financial Planning

Long‑term financial planning for the University’s real estate portfolio that anticipates and responds to legislative changes affecting higher education. Develop scenario‑based financial models and sensitivity analysis in coordination with the Office of Data Analytics and External Affairs.

Budgeting and Forecasting

Support the budgeting process, implementing financial models for accurate forecasting.

Investment and Strategic Planning and Analysis

  • Support pre‑transaction analysis and due diligence, including financial modelling, pro forma analysis, cost‑benefit or return on investment assessment, feasibility analysis, market research, and review of third‑party reports such as market demand studies, environmental assessments, appraisals, facility assessment reports.
  • Evaluate new investment opportunities and support the development of strategies for the University’s real property assets including acquisitions, development, leasing, and disposition.
  • Review all real estate agreements and contracts with the Office of General Counsel to ensure compliance with strategic plans, procedures, and applicable laws.

Project Support

  • Provide financial guidance to enhance property management financial efficiency and cost control. Support a portfolio of real estate projects encompassing development, construction, property management, legal, and financial components.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Prepare and clearly communicate transaction analysis, financial data, and strategies to university stakeholders regarding structure, economics, mission benefits, and progress.

Academic Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with the offices of the Chief Financial Officer and other members of the Administrative Services Leadership Team.

    • Presentation Support

    • Support the preparation of RFQ/RFP responses for all bids, ensuring compliance with policy, procedure, zoning laws, and public approval.
    • Prepare materials and presentations for the Facilities and Real Estate Committee and the Board of Trustees.

    Administrative Support

    • Provide administrative support as needed, including contract review and revision in coordination with outside counsel, and track and manage project budgets. Oversee these functions through completion to ensure compliance with all University processes and procedures.

    Core Competencies

    • Analytical and Strategic Thinking : Perform complex financial underwriting, structuring joint ventures, developments, and debt instruments, and gather and analyze information for well‑founded recommendations.
    • Communication, Organizational, and Interpersonal Skills : Demonstrate effective decision making, convey complex financial information clearly, build strong relationships, manage transaction pipelines, and maintain harmonious relationships with all university constituents.
    • Innovation And Problem‑Solving : Deliver creative approaches to improve financial performance and operational processes; be a team player, adaptable, and flexible.
    • Technology Proficiency : Proven strength in spreadsheets, databases, presentation applications, including Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in financial modelling and analysis tools.

    Minimum Requirements

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, or related field.
    • MBA with a concentration in Finance, Real Estate, or related field.
    • Minimum 12‑15 years of related work experience in real estate finance, underwriting, development, banking, consulting, urban planning, or public policy; experience with institutional or public‑sector projects.
    • CFA or CAIA candidate status is strongly preferred.
    • 15 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.
    • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and reporting skills.
    • Excellent communication, leadership, and project management abilities.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and financial software.

    Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

    $130,000 - $135,000

title: Biomédica / Esteticista / Fisioterapeuta - Para o cargo de Especialista do Laser - Zona Oeste/RJ
description:
Job description

Irá atuar na área de estética como Especialista do Laser realizando procedimentos de depilação a laser seguro e eficiente aos nossosclientes.


Main responsibilities

  • Executar o procedimento técnico de depilação a laser;
  • Realizará avaliação do cliente;
  • Orientar e esclarecer dúvidas sobre nosso serviço de depilação a laser;
  • Evoluir sessões do cliente em sistema registrando parâmetros utilizados e informações sobre o tratamento no prontuário eletrônico;
  • Acompanhamento das intercorrências e dúvidas sobre o resultado do tratamento, prestando assistência e esclarecimentos ao cliente, bem como processos administrativos associados;
  • Realizar venda e revenda de pacotes de depilação a laser (on-line e/ou presencial) e receber pagamentos de acordo com a política comercial;
  • Solicitação e controle de materiais e insumos para a realização dos procedimentos clínicos;
  • Organização e higienização da sala de procedimento e dos materiais utilizados;
  • Será responsável por seguir o POP (Procedimento Operacional Padrão) e protocolos estabelecidos pela empresa;
  • Zelo e utilização correta (de acordo com os protocolos de uso) da máquina do laser, checagem do bom funcionamento e realização das manutenções preventivas de todos os equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Informar todos os clientes sobre a pesquisa NPS, incentivando a avaliação para melhoria contínua do nosso relacionamento.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Estética e Cosmetologia (reconhecida pelo MEC e ter a carteira do CNPB ou CRBM ativa);
  • Formação superior em Biomedicina com Habilitação ou Pós Graduação Completa em Estética (ter a carteira do CRBM ativa);
  • Formação superior completa em Fisioterapia, crefito ativo (do estado que irá atuar);
  • Desejável experiência com atendimento ao público, captação de clientes e vendas;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semanas por escala.

Additional information

O que oferecemos?

  • Salário fixo + bonificações por metas atingidas;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Parceria de desconto com a Zenklub – (plataforma online de saúde emocional);
  • Day Off – (uma folga no mês do aniversário);
  • Parcerias educacionais com universidades e cursos de idiomas;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Executivo(a) Contas Nacional
description:
Job description

O que você irá encontrar aqui na nossa casa?

Um excelente lugar para se trabalhar! É uma alegria saber que para os nossos colaboradores, a Ypê é considerada um excelente lugar para se trabalhar! Um ambiente amistoso, de desenvolvimento profissional e confiança entre as equipes. Nossos colaboradores veem aqui a oportunidade de crescer e fazer história, seja por meio dos nossos recrutamentos internos, dos programas de desenvolvimento, treinamentos e do intercâmbio de conhecimento entre todas as nossas operações no Brasil. Aqui, praticamos nosso senso de dono quando olhamos com admiração para cada um de nossos produtos, nossos projetos sociais e o valor da nossa marca. Afinal, ela é 100% brasileira e feita por uma gente que acredita sim nas palavras de seu fundador: “O trabalho tudo vence!” .

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar a previsão de Vendas em colaboração ao processo de S&OP e Demanda
  • Negociação e implantação de Plano de Negócios e Pedidos
  • Gerir os planos de negócios (confecção, contrapartidas e pagamento de verbas)
  • Assegurar o atingimento da meta de volume, rota de execução e mix planejados
  • Alinhamento e desdobramento da estratégia comercial do canal
  • Responsável pelo desenvolvimento operacional dos clientes (Volume, mix, positivação e margem de servir)
  • Realizar rotina regular com o time do cliente garantindo treinamento, foco no portfólio e padrão no PDV de acordo com a estratégia
  • Interface e relacionamento com o time interno (Trade Marketing, Customer, Regionais de Vendas e CIEX)

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Gestão Comercial e/ou áreas correlatas; Desejável pós-graduação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote Office (Excel) e sistemas como Scanntech, Infoprice, Neogrid, etc.
  • Experiência em grandes negociações e relacionamento com cliente;
  • Ferramentas de soluções de Problemas e análise de indicadores comerciais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Additional information

Veja o que nós oferecemos:

  • Benefício Academia (Wellhub).
  • Bolsa de Estudo.
  • Cartão Gift card para produtos Ypê.
  • Convênio médico e plano odontológico.
  • Educary - Ensino para jovens e Adultos.
  • Empréstimo consignado.
  • PPR - participação nos resultados.
  • Programa Cuidar: voltado para cuidado com a saúde, e assistência social para você e sua família.
  • Seguro de vida com capital de até 24 salários.
  • Vale alimentação e refeição.

Se você tem as experiências e competências acima, estamos em busca de um profissional como você! Mas se você não se identificou com a vaga, compartilhe e faça a diferença!

Na Ypê, valorizamos o respeito e a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades que fazem cada pessoa única, incluindo: Pessoas com Deficiência, Raça e Etnia,Idade, Gênero, Crenças, Orientação sexual e Identidade de gênero. Desta forma convidamos todas as pessoas em nossos processos seletivos. #TodoMundoConta

title: Computational Scientist
description:
Join to apply for the Computational Scientist role at Halliburton

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem‑solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high‑end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.

Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device‑level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open‑source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi‑platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

Descrição da vaga

Nós somos a Fisia, a distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil. Integramos o ecossistema do Grupo SBF e acreditamos no poder transformador que o esporte tem na vida das pessoas. Somos guardiões de uma marca que está presente no dia a dia de milhões de pessoas no mundo todo. Nos primeiros passos no esporte, na velocidade das pistas de corrida, nas manobras de skate, na agilidade das chuteiras em campo, no lifestyle de quem se veste de esporte dos pés à cabeça. Contamos com um time de mais de 1.000 colaboradores, que vestem a camisa com orgulho e representam não apenas uma marca, mas o compromisso de transformar a vida dos brasileiros por meio da alegria e paixão pelo esporte.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atendimento consultivo ao cliente
  • Excelência no atendimento
  • Fidelização dos clientes
  • Garantir uma ótima experiência de compra ao cliente
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos e tendências de moda esportiva
  • Resultados e indicadores individuais de vendas (conversão e ticket médio)
  • Ser guardião da marca Nike

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência anterior com vendas em lojas varejistas
  • Habilidade com organização e reposição de produtos
  • Disponibilidade de horário (período tarde/noite)
  • Vontade de aprender e de crescer

PRAZER, GRUPO SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas.

Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar.

Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para.

Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente.

Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

title: Recruitment Consultant
description:
Talent Acquisition | Corporate Recruiter @ Airswift | Recruiting in the US, Canada & Brazil


About Us


Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.


We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.


We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction and engineering sectors.



Role Description


Hybrid schedule, from 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM (Brasilia time)


The Delivery Centre is based in Brazil and it's designed to add unique value to our client solutions whilst helping the company achieve its key strategic business goals.


Our Recruitment Consultants are responsible for supporting the global talent banking practices of qualified multi-sector candidates that match the experience, skill set, and knowledge of client job requirements that the Delivery Centre supports globally.



Principal Accountabilities



  • Ensure all candidates screened possess the correct skillset, experience, and qualifications.

  • Use all available resources and networks to successfully source new candidates (Job Boards, LinkedIn etc) for active and prospective opportunities.

  • Constantly source candidate pools across the PIE (Process, Infrastructure, Energy) to ensure a “live” network of candidates are available to react to any new requirements that may arise.

  • Deliver excellent internal service to Sales, Recruitment and Management functions within the main hub and global hubs.

  • Post and monitor job openings/responses on various web search engines and the Airswift website.

  • Fully utilise the use of the company’s Candidate Management System, web searches, networking, and advertising.

  • Interface weekly with the other Recruiters/Sales Consultants within the group, sharing best practices and market sector intelligence.

  • Demonstrate market knowledge across the PIE industry by gathering intelligence from candidates, client interactions and industry press articles.

  • Report on lead generation performance, demonstrating accountability and commitment to identifying new opportunities.

  • Maintaining and developing relationships with new and existing candidates within their assigned industry and/or discipline.

  • Consistently research and monitor competition by gathering current marketplace information and then acting upon the information by sharing it with Sales/Recruitment Functions.



Skills, Knowledge, and Experience



  • 2+ years of recruitment experience.

  • Bachelor’s degree (completed or about to be).

  • Experience working in a recruitment agency is a plus.

  • Experience working in the Energy industry is a plus.

  • Dynamic personality with the ability to work with well-defined processes.

  • Ambitious goals with the ability to handle themselves under pressure in a fast-paced, competitive and KPI-focused environment.



What we can offer you



  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.

  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!

  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.

  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.

  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.

  • Career breaks available after one year.

  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.

  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.

  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)

  • Charity days for various important causes, such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.



Our Core Values



  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growthrequires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.

  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.

  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.

  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.



Visit our website and social media to find out more! -

Atuar no desenvolvimento, customização e integração das soluções de Workforce Management, com foco em Salesforce Field Service (FSL) e/ou Oracle Field Service (OFS/TOA).   • Experiência prática em backend (Node.js/TypeScript ou Java).
  • Conhecimento sólido em APIs REST (design, consumo, segurança).

  • Vivência em CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).

Desejável

  • Vivência em Service Cloud (Salesforce).

  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (logs estruturados, ELK, Datadog).
  • Noções de mensageria (Kafka ou RabbitMQ).

Diferenciais Competitivos

  • Experiência em otimização de agendas, regras de atribuição e mobilidade em plataformas de Field Service.
  • Certificações Salesforce (FSL, Service Cloud) ou Oracle Field Service.
  • Participação em projetos de alta disponibilidade ou missão crítica.
  • Experiência em integração entre chatbots e sistemas de campo.

Soft Skills Esperados

  • Boa comunicação técnica e clareza na interação com áreas de negócio.
  • Autonomia para conduzir entregas e apoiar colegas menos experientes.
  • Proatividade para identificar melhorias técnicas ou funcionais.
  • Colaboração em equipes multidisciplinares, com postura de co-responsabilidade.

Perfil Esperado

  • Profissional pleno, com domínio consistente de backend e experiência em Field Service.
  • Atuação autônoma na execução, mas colaborativa no desenho de soluções mais complexas.

  • Monitorar o suprimento de materiais e equipamentos em estoque, sinalizar necessidade ou efetuar solicitações necessárias, realizar a conferência no ato do recebimento e organizar a alocação;

description:
Sobre o Hospital

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar processos de Recrutamento e Seleção para profissionais de todas as categorias, obedecendo aos métodos adotados pela Instituição.

  • Ensino Superior completo em Gestão de RH ou Superior cursando a partir do 5° semestre em Psicologia;
  • Conhecimento em entrevista por competências;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 meses em atuação na área de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Overview

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor)

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the principal job elements essential for making a fair decision regarding the pay structure of the job. #ogjs

Overview

(Rio de Janeiro) Gerente Paula Cotrim | Vendas - Seguros de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atuação Presencial)

Descrição da vaga: Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros! Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;
  • Após a conquista da Habilitação:
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.

Informações adicionais

  • PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO: São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira. E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula - onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará - com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas - as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Conheça as vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros

  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.

Sobre a MAG: Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. title: REGIONAL ACCOUNT MANAGER MLAC - FCM
description:
Overview

REGIONAL ACCOUNT MANAGER MLAC - FCM

Regional Account Manager (Latin America)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses. Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries with global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About The Opportunity

  • This specific role of Regional Account Management is designed to manage the relationship between FCM Travel Solutions and clients.
  • FCM OBW Experts are designed to lead by demonstrated performance within the business and be experts within all facets of their AM role.
  • The provision of these travel programs will be in accordance with the global and/or regional agreement. The strategic intent of these programs will be to provide consolidation, which in turn delivers savings through spend leverage, tightened program control and consistent operational services.

Client programs will be built on agreed global and regional requirements whilst taking into consideration local market diversities.

Key Responsibilities

  • OBW Expert to conduct regular reviews with (region) based FCM Partner Account Managers (AMs).
  • Ensure areas of required training for the role, business acumen and FCM product suite are undertaken by AM.
  • Ensure organic growth is encouraged and streamlined within the region. Use lighthouse to track and monitor.
  • Ensure retention of client is achieved within contract and matters escalated where clients are at risk.
  • All Partner Account Managers’ performance to be actively demonstrated by each AM, eg., monthly reports (as applicable), use of client handbooks, active business planning including local market recommendations, ownership fees & overdues, regular local client meetings, maintenance of client OBT, active management of client feedback, monitor of expenditure, local identification of growth/leakage.
  • All Partner Account Managers are encouraged to communicate up to the Multinational Account Managers; escalate service issues that are serious in nature, in breach of contract or need additional support from Multinational Account Management teams; escalate requests from clients which are outside the client’s service agreement and contract; escalate matters where interpretation of client policies, process, suppliers or technology structure is unclear.
  • Provide quarterly client updates to the nominated client Multinational Account Management team.
  • Guide AMs to access online libraries in Lighthouse and the FCM Global Extranet and access current documents and templates as required.
  • Provide input into FCM’s Account Management global procedures through monitoring competitive activity across the industry, requirements of our FCM partners and requirements of our clients.
  • OBW Expert to engage with FCM Multinational Account Manager and the Network Leader(s) (Region) and provide feedback of local market FCM partner performance.
  • Develop and execute a multinational business plan, detailing objectives, strategies and measurable targets, deployed with each local Account Manager.
  • In partnership with local country FCM Account Managers complete a regular assessment of the client travel program in relation to the business plan.
  • Direct Savings - Review opportunities and cost benefits for supplier contracts. Ensure local country supplier contracts are benchmarked and assistance provided to local/regional client during contract supplier negotiations.
  • Indirect Savings - Review booking and expense management procedures and ensure consistency and efficiency across the region. Provide recommendations on suggested changes.
  • Prescribe results on savings and maintain across the region.
  • Drive client compliance and growth with directly procured products and services from FCM; air, hotel, car, rail, ground transport, insurance and VIP Services. Ensure client exposure to secondary products and services; expense management solutions, MIR, accounts payable solutions (billing platforms), hotel programs, travel booking procedures (online technology) and event management (CIEvents).
  • Using the Service Level Agreement work with local country FCM Account Managers and Operational teams to drive a common service delivery for the client. Ensure consistent interpretation and administration of travel policy, utilisation of negotiated supplier deals and implementation of business plan to drive client goals.
  • Responsible for the multinational client implementation plan, coordinating all departments and function groups (Online Booking Tools, Global Reporting, Operations, Products, Sales, Change Management & Communication, Credit/Payments).
  • Work with local country FCM Account Managers to provide assistance to the client for local, multi-market and/or global supplier agreements (airlines, car rental, insurance). Hotel program procurement should be managed by the FCM Hotel Product team.
  • Ability to prepare annual Airline Opportunity Analysis for client(s) and conduct annual Travel Policy Opportunity analysis and assessment including benchmarking to like clients.
  • Provide recommendations to clients on strategic direction of program in respect to booking, payment settlement and compliance benchmarked to like clients.
  • Maintain a central reference source file for the Operational and Account Management teams managing regional clients, containing client policies, forms, templates, procedures and client negotiated supplier information.
  • Maintain accurate and up to date client information in FCM Lighthouse. Ensure all company hierarchy, client contacts, important communications, contracts, monthly/quarterly/annual reporting and reviews are recorded in the account record. All time on events and tasks to be recorded against the client profile.
  • Represent the client within FCM and communicate required matters of contractual delivery.
  • Be the first point of contact for the client’s multinational Travel Manager and all key stakeholders at the country level.
  • Using the FCM MIR tools, provide formal reviews of the client’s travel program including analysis, commentary and recommendations pertinent to the client, their business plan and local supplier tactics. Reviews will be delivered on a maximum quarterly basis in a format agreed in the Service Level Agreement.
  • MAM to develop and maintain multi level client relationships.
  • Control the account management budget for the identified client portfolio. Actively work to recover all costs.
  • Quarterly provision and detailed analysis of client-generated income for multinational account management services, including correct accumulation of Multinational Account Management Fees and on-charge of additional fees as agreed with the client.
  • Work regularly with FCM Multinational Sales Leaders on new and existing business opportunities. Be active and contribute at team meetings and regional meetings.
  • Provide input into FCM’s one best way through monitoring competitive activity in the home and regional markets.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelors Degree in Management
  • 5+ years experience in Account Management LATAM Markets

Work Perks & Benefits

  • Have fun: At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering.
  • Use your smarts: Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.

Job Purpose

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Interacts with physicians, immediate staff members, research participants, and the general public.

  • Maintain familiarity with the protocol. Evaluate study candidates for eligibility into the study.

  • Respond to data inquiries in a timely manner.
  • Complete Serious Adverse Event Reports within the proper timeframes.
  • Report to the Project Director and the Principal Investigator regarding assignments and duties.

title: Field Service Technician - Temporary 12 months
description:
Field Service Technician - Temporary 12 months

Join to apply for the Field Service Technician - Temporary 12 months role at Flowserve Corporation.

Job Summary

The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries, such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. In this position, the Field Service Technician (FST) offers real-time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment. The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites. Our team of Field Service Technicians is the face of Flowserve and we rely on them to provide world-class service to our customers, creating a lasting competitive advantage for our products and services.

Responsibilities

  • Perform direct, in-person service calls in response to customer requests;
  • Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly;
  • Work side-by-side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required;
  • Supervising the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly;
  • Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule;
  • Checking equipment before commissioning and start-up and evaluating performance during and after equipment start-up;
  • Monitoring the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment;
  • Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products;
  • Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering;
  • Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged;
  • Other duties as assigned;

Requirements

  • Mechanical Technician with active CFT;
  • Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry;
  • Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment;
  • Experience in installing mechanical equipment;
  • Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc.;
  • Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference;
  • Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges;
  • Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;
  • Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills;
  • Intermediate English
  • An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job;
  • Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods;
  • Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers;
  • Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

Desirable Skills

  • Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable;
  • Professional certifications in this area.

About Flowserve

Flowserve is a world-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. We support 10,000+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet needs of customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally.

Preenchimento dos planos assistenciais dos pacientes com fístula durante 1 ano de admissão e com cateter duplo lúmen; Em atendimento ambulatorial, realizar a avaliação nutricional dos pacientes em tratamento oncológico com base no histórico clínico, avaliação física, antropométrica, dados bioquímicos, entre outros, a fim de elaborar o diagnóstico e a conduta nutricional, registrando dados em sistema GestHos; Orientação e seguimento nutricional do paciente no ambulatório de nutrição sempre que a ASG-PPP (anexo 01 POP NCL 20) evidenciar risco (escore numérico de 4-8), para continuidade do cuidado e promover manutenção e/ou recuperação do estado nutricional; Observar as normas de segurança, controle ambiental e outras internas e/ou a legislação, pertinentes à suas atividades; Participar e sugerir melhorias nas ferramentas da qualidade, conferência e aplicabilidade de POP, Gerenciamento de Risco e Mapa de processo; Executar outras tarefas similares às acima descritas a critério do gestor; Realizar o gerenciamento e monitoramento da governança clinica dos setores sob sua responsabilidade através da Gestão de treinamentos, Gestão dos custos e orçamentos setoriais, Gestão de pessoas, Gestão de resultados, Gestão de desenvolvimento de equipes, Gestão de riscos setoriais e Gestão de desempenho de qualidade
